soundness_flags.label: def:tube-coefficient-extractor; thm:unequal-three-arm-allocation-tube; thm:unequal-three-arm-effective-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The instruction to apply an unspecified Euler--Maclaurin expansion and “collect the coefficient” does not uniquely define \(\mathcal J_{\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\), \(C_{\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{shell}}^\dagger\), or \(\beta^\dagger\), so the displayed tube and certificate bounds presently lack determinate right-hand sides.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies the binary-treatment finite-population ATE, identifies its unrestricted minimax game with a scalar reduced experiment, and proves \(\rho_n^*=n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3})\) attained by Bernoulli(1/2) randomization and nonlinear shrinkage.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1 abstract; pp. 7--8, Theorem 1; pp. 17--19, proof Steps 1--3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 concerns two potential-outcome coordinates, all measurable estimators, and bounded outcomes; its proof symmetrizes by per-unit coordinate swaps and yields independent Bernoulli(1/2) assignment.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 565 abstract; pp. 569--570, Theorem 3.1 and Remark 3.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes minimax complete randomization under permutation-invariant distribution classes and, under additional assumptions, linear difference-in-means-type schemes with Neyman allocations.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--3 introduction; pp. 13--16, Theorem 5.1 and Corollary 5.1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper treats sequential designs with covariates and past outcomes, extends its setup to multiple treatments and constraints, and gives a local asymptotic efficiency bound rather than a finite-population second-order minimax expansion.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace def:tube-coefficient-extractor with an explicit finite multi-index expansion: state the summation variables, cellwise change of variables, coefficient formula, remainder norm, shell partition, and parameter schedules that define each of \(\mathcal J\), \(C\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{shell}}\), and \(\beta\).

After defining the coefficient object, add a standalone strict K=3-versus-K=2 nonreducibility theorem tying the eight-type likelihood and transverse direction to the exact failure of the published scalar ancillary reduction.

Keep the Airy restricted-independent-design result explicitly separate from the unrestricted tube kernel until a proved matching-primal map connects them; this prevents an auxiliary spectral benchmark from being read as an assumed all-design limit.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: make the tube coefficient and all error moduli mathematically explicit before sending the sharp-limit kernel to Stage 0.
